scene-01.text: First, we have the DC motor. The propeller will be fitted onto the shaft of the motor.

scene-02.text: Next, take the blue propeller and identify the opening at its center.

scene-03.text: Align the center of the propeller with the shaft of the DC motor.

scene-04.text: Carefully slide the center hub of the propeller onto the motor shaft until it is firmly in place.

scene-05.text: The propeller is now fitted onto the DC motor shaft.
